answer: Agents must present TPM/SGX remote-attestation proofs with a zero-knowledge proof binding code, device key, and a delta state-tree root to a ledge hash anchor; the signal consensus contract rejects duplicate hardware identities. Forging requires compromising attested silicon or continuously provisioning distinct physical devices and recomputing proofs. A quadratic bonding curve O(N^2) prices identities, while fraud triggers irreversible collateral slashing.
